final_candidate.title: EffectSlice: Eligibility-Gated Certificates for Task-Local Procedural Effects
final_candidate.hook: Once a complete paper-derived skill has a sealed positive net effect on one locked user task, a nonempty source-grounded slice may preserve that effect while executing fewer procedures. EffectSlice certifies only this task-local reduction and abstains when the full effect, units, statistical family, or complete neighbor audit is invalid.
final_candidate.hook_shape_rationale: This is counter-intuitive minimalism: relative to an eligible complete artifact, the candidate uses strictly fewer frozen procedural atoms while preserving its sealed cost-adjusted task effect, contract, and guardrails. A surprising empirical reveal was rejected because the eight existing tasks are development evidence only; the admission test must be passed on at least four genuinely new held-out paper-task pairs.

gap_closure.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by a nonempty deterministic procedural-subset object whose exact SCC quotient preserves the original feasible family and whose faithfulness criterion is sealed paired equivalence to a complete artifact with a strictly positive cost-adjusted effect.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved frontier estimates net benefit after execution cost, adaptation effort, and regressions on task dimensions outside the paper's headline metric are deducted from gross performance gain.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by making cost-adjusted paired effect, contract validity, and guardrail noninferiority simultaneous fields of the same sealed source-grounded subset certificate rather than independent proxy scores.

final_candidate.core_mechanism: For one paper p and independently locked user task tau, preregister a same-scaffold no-skill baseline B, the complete PaperToSkill artifact F, task cases and weights, primary scorer m in [0,1], guardrail scorers r_j in [0,1], GPU/API/labor conversion weights, delta_min > 0, 0 < epsilon <= delta_min/2, guardrail margins eta_j, alpha_total=0.05 with alpha_F=0.01, alpha_D=0.02, and alpha_C=0.02, total distinct-slice query budget Q=24, and post-condensation atom cap N=16. A sealed eligibility family runs paired F and B branches and continues only if every contract and guardrail condition passes and the simultaneous one-sided lower confidence bound L_F for the cost- and regression-adjusted effect Delta_tau(F) is strictly greater than delta_min; null or negative F yields no_validated_beneficial_effect. A deterministic compiler parses the frozen SKILL.md with a pinned CommonMark grammar into ordered executable workflow-step leaves, intersects each leaf with exact source_map line spans, pinned executable regions identified by file path plus AST-qualified symbol or tool-call template, and one role from the preregistered task-contract role vocabulary, then emits maximal nonempty regions sharing the tuple (workflow step, source span, executable region, contract role); missing anchors, overlapping boundaries that cannot be split exactly, multiple role assignments, or any other ambiguous tuple terminate with ambiguous_atomization rather than invoking an LLM tie-breaker. Let G=(V,E) use these tuple atoms with edge u->v meaning u requires v; its SCC condensation D is an exact quotient because every dependency-closed original subset is a union of SCCs, so Phi(S)={C:C is contained in S} is a bijection to downward-closed subsets of D with inverse Union(T), the lifted feasibility predicate P_D(T)=P_G(Union(T)), and Delta_D(T)=Delta_G(Union(T)); therefore condensation changes neither the feasible family nor the effect definition, and D with more than 16 nodes yields granularity_out_of_scope. The candidate family contains only nonempty, source-valid, executable, contract-passing downward-closed T with strictly fewer original atoms than F; the empty set is rejected before evaluation, and a dependency-relative neighbor removes one retained SCC plus every selected SCC that depends on it. For any artifact A, Delta_tau(A) is its weighted paired primary-score improvement over B minus preregistered GPU, API, labor, and guardrail-regression penalties; G_tau(T)=Delta_tau(Union(T))-Delta_tau(F), I_tau(T) is its simultaneous confidence interval, and the load-bearing margin is M_tau(T)=epsilon-sup{|g|:g in I_tau(T)}, so L_F>delta_min and epsilon<=delta_min/2 prevent a B-equivalent or zero-effect slice from passing even before the explicit nonempty rule. The preregistered family H_F covers F's beneficial-effect and guardrail eligibility statements, H_D covers both effect-equivalence sides and all guardrail-noninferiority statements for every adaptively proposed slice using predictable alpha_{D,q}=6 alpha_D/(pi^2 q^2), and H_C covers both effect-equivalence sides and every guardrail statement for the locked slice plus the effect and guardrail failure statements for every retained-SCC deletion neighbor; Holm adjustment is used inside each sealed family and each discovery query's allocated family, so alpha_F+alpha_D+alpha_C<=alpha_total covers effect, guardrails, and retained-deletion hypotheses end to end. SCC condensation is the single exact compression used for C00 tractability, after which the interchangeable search backend may spend at most Q-N=8 discovery queries and must reserve enough of Q to evaluate the complete final retained-SCC neighbor scan; if q_discovery+|T_star|>Q, it returns insufficient_query_budget, and confirmation reruns only already registered hypotheses. Cert_tau(T_star) contains the frozen four-way atom inventory, quotient/inverse maps, source and execution hashes, F eligibility record, M_tau, contracts, guardrails, alpha ledger, Q ledger, and corrected retained-neighbor evidence; the proposed contribution is limited to binding a paper-derived artifact's deterministic source units to a positive-full-effect gate and sealed task-local effect-preservation decision, with no novelty claim for subset search, SCC quotienting, statistical tests, provenance, equivalence testing, or dependency-relative one-deletion minimality. Within H_C, preregister one sealed Holm family containing both effect-equivalence sides and every guardrail-noninferiority statement for T_star, the effect and guardrail failure statements for every retained-SCC deletion neighbor, both effect-equivalence sides and every guardrail statement for the frozen M_tau-permuted negative-control output, both effect-equivalence sides and every guardrail statement for each frozen direct ClawTrace, Graph-of-Skills, and SkillRAE output, and every held-out correctly-admitted-nonempty-compact-artifact rate contrast used for the claim. Rebalance critical values across this enumerated family within the unchanged alpha_C=0.02; alpha_total, alpha_F, alpha_D, Q, branch counts, task, metric, and claim remain exactly as preregistered. The load-bearing worker is reducer-agnostic: for each held-out task, freeze EffectSlice's proposed slice and the direct ClawTrace, Graph-of-Skills, and SkillRAE outputs before confirmation, map each output through the identical deterministic atom compiler, and submit every resulting candidate to the same beneficial-F eligibility condition, nonempty/compact and atom/source-validity checks, contract checks, and sealed H_C admission gate under matched branch budgets. The success quantity is the correctly admitted nonempty compact-artifact rate, with incorrect admissions and all gate abstentions retained, so the mechanism claim is limited to this admission decision and not to subset search, pruning, SCC condensation, provenance, equivalence testing, or local minimality.
final_candidate.core_mechanism_reasoning: Both selected gaps share one object, Cert_tau(T): the first requires faithfulness to the complete artifact's direct downstream effect, while the second requires that the same effect deduct measured cost and guardrail regressions. The exact SCC quotient was chosen as C00's tractability move because its projection and inverse preserve every dependency-closed original subset and its measured effect; approximate graph embeddings, semantic atom merging, and learned pruning were rejected because they would alter the certified family or reintroduce ambiguous units. Search, quotienting, noninferiority statistics, provenance, and local minimality are established machinery and remain infrastructure or baselines rather than contributions.
final_candidate.core_mechanism_steps:
1. Freeze tau's cases, weights, scorer, guardrails, contract-role vocabulary, B, F, delta_min, 0<epsilon<=delta_min/2, eta_j, cost weights, alpha_total=0.05, alpha_F/alpha_D/alpha_C, Q=24, parser versions, and all seed pools; output an immutable manifest.
2. Run paired F/B eligibility branches and compute the simultaneous one-sided lower bound L_F; return no_validated_beneficial_effect unless L_F>delta_min and every contract and guardrail condition passes.
3. Parse SKILL.md workflow leaves, exact source_map spans, pinned executable regions, and contract roles; split only at explicit boundaries and return ambiguous_atomization for any missing, overlapping, unanchored, or multiply assigned tuple.
4. Build the original dependency graph, compute its SCC condensation, emit Phi and Union maps, mechanically verify the dependency-closed/downward-closed bijection and Delta_D(T)=Delta_G(Union(T)) on the frozen executor, and return granularity_out_of_scope if N>16.
5. Reject the empty set, materialize the full nonempty downward-closed set, and reserve N of Q for the complete final neighbor scan, leaving at most Q-N discovery proposals.
6. Let an interchangeable deletion or slicing baseline propose a nonempty downward-closed T_q from prior discovery data before its fresh paired T_q/F/B seed block is revealed; log the proposal and predictable alpha_{D,q}.
7. Execute T_q, F, and B, update I_tau(T_q) and M_tau(T_q), and retain T_q only if M_tau(T_q)>0 with no corrected contract or guardrail failure; never change units, epsilon, scorers, task, or alpha allocation after outcomes.
8. Lock T_star, enumerate every dependency-relative retained-SCC deletion neighbor, and evaluate all of them within Q; return insufficient_query_budget or not_certified_locally_irreducible if the scan is incomplete or any neighbor is not shown to fail a corrected effect, contract, or guardrail condition.
9. On untouched confirmation seeds, rerun F, B, T_star, every registered deletion neighbor, the M_tau-permuted negative control, and direct ClawTrace, Graph-of-Skills, and SkillRAE outputs under matched task and branch budgets; apply the sealed H_C correction and emit Cert_tau only for a nonempty passing T_star.
10. Develop on the eight existing tasks, freeze all code and manifests, then evaluate at least four genuinely new paper-task pairs separately; report abstentions for ineligible F, ambiguous atoms, N>16, empty slices, and insufficient Q rather than dropping them.
final_candidate.falsification_prediction: After development on the existing eight tasks, freeze the parser, atomization, quotient, eligibility rule, margins, alpha families, Q ledger, search worker, and budgets, then acquire at least four genuinely new paper-task pairs with untouched source maps, complete artifacts, assets, and scorers; run EffectSlice and direct ClawTrace, Graph-of-Skills, and SkillRAE baselines under matched task and branch budgets. Among held-out pairs whose F has sealed L_F>delta_min, a successful mechanism should increase the rate of nonempty compact artifacts whose untouched-confirmation paired effect gap remains inside [-epsilon,epsilon] with no corrected contract or guardrail failure, while reducing original procedure count and measured local cost relative to F; all abstentions remain in the denominator. The single load-bearing variable is M_tau(T)=epsilon-sup{|g|:g in I_tau(T)}. As a negative control, permute discovery M_tau labels among same-size contract-passing candidates before selection and evaluate the selected candidate on untouched confirmation seeds; its downstream paired effect gap should leave [-epsilon,epsilon] and move toward the no-skill baseline more often than for the unpermuted worker.
final_candidate.compute_budget: Upper-bound campaign: 12 tasks total (8 development plus at least 4 genuinely new held-out), N<=16 SCC atoms, Q=24 distinct slice hypotheses including at most Q-N=8 adaptive discovery candidates and up to N=16 final deletion neighbors, two fresh paired discovery seeds per T/F/B branch, three sealed F/B eligibility seeds, and five confirmation seeds for F, B, T_star, up to 16 deletion neighbors, the M_tau-permuted control, and three direct baselines. This is at most 48 discovery + 6 eligibility + 115 confirmation = 169 branch-runs per task, or 2,028 branch-runs total; at preregistered caps of 0.25 GPU-hour and $1.50 API per branch plus a 15% rerun reserve, the full upper bound is 24.3 GPU-days on 80GB-class GPUs + $3,500 API, with deterministic parsing and SCC construction charged as CPU-only. If the pilot exceeds either per-branch cap, or Q cannot include every final neighbor, the run returns budget_infeasible or insufficient_query_budget rather than reducing seeds or hypotheses after outcomes.
